message: I am trying to adjust a soup recipe for six people. The original serves four and uses 800 grams of tomatoes, two onions and 600 millilitres of stock. I want to keep the same proportions, but I will add salt gradually after tasting. One guest avoids dairy, so please do not suggest cream as a garnish.
